action_items: Deterministic assessment rules are MOCKED rather than backed by a live LLM agent.
Document review/OCR, video processing/transcription, and external AI integrations are MOCKED demo surfaces.
No authentication is implemented for this public prototype.

checks.criterion: Integrated Educaro applicant journey is visible on the dashboard
checks.name: dashboard-profile-workspace-api
checks.evidence: GET /api/applicant -> 200; response id demo-applicant with pathway, documents, qualification, recommendation, and four agent steps.

checks.criterion: Applicant intake progressively builds the profile
checks.name: intake-updates-assessment-api
checks.evidence: POST /api/applicant/intake -> 200; returned demo-applicant with submitted name/city, assessment fields, and four agent steps. Invalid payload -> 422.

checks.criterion: Supporting documents can be added and clearly sourced
checks.name: documents-review-source-api
checks.evidence: POST /api/applicant/documents -> 200; returned tscheck-journey-evidence.pdf with kind cv, status review, source applicant-provided. Unknown kind -> 422.

checks.criterion: Integrated Educaro applicant journey is visible on the dashboard
checks.name: educaro-dashboard-workspace
checks.evidence: Public preview displayed Educaro shell, pathway/profile cards, documents, qualification, recommendation, and agent trace; screenshot captured.

checks.criterion: Applicant intake progressively builds the profile
checks.name: educaro-intake-updates-profile
checks.evidence: Continue intake opened the guided form; submitted Browser Check Applicant/Hyderabad, panel closed, and summary updated.

checks.criterion: Supporting documents can be added and clearly sourced
checks.name: educaro-adds-evidence-document
checks.evidence: Add document opened evidence locker; submitted Browser Check Portfolio.pdf; list showed Applicant provided and Review queue after panel closed.

checks.criterion: Qualification assessment shows requirements and next step
checks.name: educaro-qualification-next-step
checks.evidence: Qualification card showed progress number, current signal, Open requirements, recommendation copy, and enabled primary action.

checks.name: educaro-agent-trace-visible
checks.evidence: Agent trace visibly rendered Profile assembled, Evidence mapped, Requirements checked, and Next step selected with status markers.

checks.name: educaro-desktop-layout-reachable
checks.evidence: 1280x720 desktop check showed sidebar/header/main content and successfully reached Documents and Qualification navigation targets.
